title: The 3 Best Travel Adapters for International Travel
h1: The 3 Best Travel Adapters for International Travel
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for travel adapters for international travel, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at travel adapters for international travel using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: OREI World Travel Plug Adapter M8 Max
products.blurb: Key specs: 2 USA-standard outlets, 3 USB-A ports plus 1 USB-C PD 18W port, Interchangeable plug attachments for 150+ countries.
strengths: Six charging points in one unit, two AC outlets and four USB ports
18W USB-C PD port charges a phone meaningfully faster than USB-A-only competitors
Grounded plug design adds a safety margin over ungrounded 2-prong adapters
Interchangeable heads mean one unit for an entire multi-country itinerary
limitations: Larger footprint than compact single-outlet adapters
18W USB-C is enough for a phone but not fast enough to usefully charge a laptop
Some plug heads fit slightly loose on certain regional outlet styles per owner reports
features: 3 USB-A ports plus 1 USB-C PD 18W port

products.name: BESTEK Universal Travel Adapter
products.blurb: Key specs: 100-220V to 110V step-down voltage conversion, 250W, 6A 4-port USB charging, 3 AC sockets.
strengths: Genuine step-down voltage conversion, not just a plug shape adapter, matters for single-voltage hair tools
Three AC sockets plus four USB ports cover a full family's devices from one wall plug
Wide plug attachment set covers most common destinations
limitations: 250W ceiling means it cannot run high-draw appliances like full-size hair dryers
Bulkier and heavier than plug-only adapters since it houses conversion electronics
Audible fan noise reported by some owners during conversion

products.name: OREI World Travel Plug Adapter
products.blurb: Key specs: 2 USB-A ports (2A each), 1 universal AC outlet, Slide-out plug attachments for Europe, Asia, China, Japan, Africa.
strengths: Lowest price of any kit-style adapter in this list without dropping multi-country coverage
Compact size fits easily in a daypack side pocket
Safety shutters block accidental contact with live pins, a nice touch at this price
limitations: Only one AC outlet, so a laptop and a lamp cannot be plugged in simultaneously
2A USB ports are noticeably slower than PD-equipped competitors for tablets
features: Slide-out plug attachments for Europe, Asia, China, Japan, Africa
Built-in safety shutters and fuse protection

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
